definitions.rationale: This structural abbreviation expands the named iscubeProgram proof term into the exact MPY constructor tree; it defines a named program representation rather than asserting an additional mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule iscubeProgram =>
    Module(
      FuncDef("iscube", Params("a"),
        If(Compare(Name("a"), CmpOp("<", Int(0))),
          Assign(Name("a"), UnaryOp("-", Name("a"))),
          .Stmts)
        Assign(Name("n"), Int(0))
        While(Compare(
          BinOp("*", BinOp("*", Name("n"), Name("n")), Name("n")),
          CmpOp("<", Name("a"))),
          Assign(Name("n"), BinOp("+", Name("n"), Int(1))))
        Return(Compare(
          BinOp("*", BinOp("*", Name("n"), Name("n")), Name("n")),
          CmpOp("==", Name("a"))))))

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the verification helper cube(I) to mean I *Int I *Int I.

source_rules.rationale: This simplification rule supplies a nontrivial open-cube-gap arithmetic implication. Stage 1 compiles GAP-VERIFICATION with the rule already present before proving GAP-SPEC, so its exact statement is not separately proved against a module that omits it.
source_rules.text:
rule I <Int N +Int 1 => true
    requires 0 <=Int I
     andBool I <=Int N +Int 1
     andBool 0 <=Int N
     andBool 0 <Int D
     andBool D <Int ((N +Int 1) *Int (N +Int 1) *Int (N +Int 1))
                       -Int (N *Int N *Int N)
     andBool (I *Int I *Int I) <Int (N *Int N *Int N) +Int D
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: This simplification rule supplies the nontrivial arithmetic fact that the stopped loop index equals N +Int 1 under the open-gap hypotheses. Stage 1 includes the rule in GAP-VERIFICATION before proving GAP-SPEC and provides no prior proof of this exact rule in a module without it.
source_rules.text:
rule I ==Int N +Int 1 => true
    requires 0 <=Int I
     andBool I <=Int N +Int 1
     andBool 0 <=Int N
     andBool 0 <Int D
     andBool D <Int ((N +Int 1) *Int (N +Int 1) *Int (N +Int 1))
                       -Int (N *Int N *Int N)
     andBool (I *Int I *Int I) >=Int (N *Int N *Int N) +Int D
    [simplification]
